one_month_reasoning: In-window events: Q3 2026 results, most likely Thu Oct 22 (FCX has not yet announced the date; it reported Q3 on Oct 19-23 in every recent year and has reported on Thursdays in 2026), against consensus EPS of $0.74 on guided sales of 750M lb at a $6.00 deck. Copper averaged well above that deck in Q3, so a beat is plausible, and the first 2027 outlook (copper sales guided >20% higher, gold >50% higher, capex $4.8B) should be reiterated. Offsetting this: the stock jumped 4.5% on Sep 30; LME copper retreated to $14,457/t in the week to Sep 30, and SMM expects a further dip ($14,200-14,650) as COMEX and LME stocks both rise. The COMEX-LME arbitrage window is closed, so there is no front-month tariff premium left to unwind. The refined-copper tariff remains undecided after the notional Sep 28 window. Also in the window: Manyar smelter restart news, the Escondida labour outcome and the China National Day holiday. Net: roughly symmetric, centred at ~$70.5 (essentially spot), with ~13.5% monthly vol (48%/3.5) and a modestly fat left tail for the earnings print.

fair_value.method: Blend of attributable P/E (2027E EPS $4.10 x 17x = $70, weight 0.5), attributable FCF yield (~$3.35/share 2027 FCF at a 5.0% yield = $67, weight 0.3) and a rebuilt consolidated EV/EBITDA (2028 run-rate $17B x 8.5x less $5.3B net debt and ~$52B NCI market value = ~$60, weight 0.2) gives ~$67, just below spot.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: 2027E EPS $4.10 x 17x. The bridge is ~$16.9B EBITDA at a ~$6.10/lb deck, less ~$2.6B DD&A and ~$0.3B interest = ~$14.0B pretax; 32% tax; ~38% NCI; 1.443B shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Management's 2027 model gives ~$13B at $5 and ~$20B at $7 (~$350M per 10c). Deck of $6.10: a mean-reversion haircut to today's ~$6.56 (LME $14,457/t, SMM Sep 30). The supervisor and SMM show that spot is now an LME-level price with no COMEX front-month premium, so I raised the deck slightly from the implicit ~$6.00.
The 2026 guided ETR is ~30% (Peru 40%, Indonesia 36%, US 7%). I raised it to 32% for a higher Indonesian mix as Grasberg ramps.
NCI took 33% of H1 2026 net income with Grasberg impaired and 52% of H1 2025 at full rate. With Grasberg at 75-100% in 2027 the share should be about 38%.
($16.9B - $2.6B - $0.3B) x 0.68 x 0.62 / 1.443B = ~$4.0-4.1. Consistent with consensus of $4.16 (17 analysts).
FCX trades at ~17-18x forward (24/7 Wall St; $70.58 / $4.16). By Sept 2027 the market will look at 2028 full-Grasberg EPS (~$4.5 at 16x = ~$72), so 17x on 2027 is a fair 12-month-out multiple.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: 2027 OCF ~$12.7B at a ~$6.10 deck less $4.8B capex = ~$7.9B; ~61% attributable = ~$4.8B / 1.443B = ~$3.35/share at a 5.0% required yield

inputs_detail.derivation: Management's 2027 model gives ~$12.5B OCF at $6 copper. Nudged up for the $6.10 deck.
Slightly below 1 - 38% NCI because PTFI (the highest-NCI unit) carries a large share of the capex-light incremental cash.
A cyclical copper major at record prices warrants a yield above the ~4.5% implied by today's price. SMM's near-term outlook is for softer copper.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2028 run-rate consolidated EBITDA $17B x 8.5x = $144.5B; less net debt $5.3B and NCI market value ~$52B = ~$87B / 1.443B = ~$60

inputs_detail.derivation: Full Grasberg by end-2027 (200k tpd ore by 2027 vs 156k in 2026, per Indonesian press). Uses management's sensitivity at a mid-cycle ~$5.75-5.90/lb, below the P/E deck because it is a 2028+ run-rate.
Raised from 7x. Once NCI is valued properly, the market pays ~9x consolidated EBITDA at spot; 8.5x allows modest multiple compression from record copper.

inputs_detail.value: $5.3B ($9.4B debt - $4.1B cash, incl. $3.2B PTFI smelter debt)

inputs_detail.derivation: Book NCI is $12.1B against $20.1B FCX equity. At ~38% of net income, NCI is worth ~0.6x FCX equity value (~$87B), i.e. ~$52B. Round-1's $15B was barely above book.

bear.story: Copper falls to ~$4.75-5.00/lb: rate hikes (the Fed hiked in September), China demand softens, and COMEX's ~770k short tons plus rising LME/SHFE stocks weigh on the market. Or the Grasberg ramp slips again (PB2/3 capped at ~60% until the chute fix). 2027 EBITDA ~$13B, EPS ~$2.8-3.0 at ~15-16x.

base.story: Copper eases to $5.90-6.30/lb. Grasberg hits 75-80% by mid-2027 and approaches full rate by year-end. The Manyar smelter ramps. 2027 EPS ~$4.1 and 2028 ~$4.5 at 16-17x.

bull.story: Chilean supply issues persist (Escondida labour, Codelco declines, acid shortage), a 2027 US tariff keeps stocks trapped in the US and LME tight, and copper holds $7+/lb. Grasberg reaches full rate early. EBITDA ~$20B+, EPS ~$5.5 at ~19-20x.

thesis_break_reason: Around $47 (-33%) the stock would be discounting copper back near $5/lb (~$13B EBITDA, ~$3.0 EPS at 15-16x) or a second Grasberg setback / adverse IUPK extension terms. That is beyond ordinary 45-48% vol noise over a few months and would mean the ramp-plus-price thesis failed. I trimmed it from $48 because the corrected NCI and tax inputs put $5 copper at ~$3.0 EPS.

reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor's corrections cut my fair value from $72 to $67. First, my EPS bridge used a 40% tax rate (guided ETR ~30%) and a 25% NCI share (actual 33% in H1 2026, 52% in H1 2025). Rebuilt at 32% tax and 38% NCI on ~$16.9B EBITDA ($6.10 deck), 2027E EPS is ~$4.10, close to the $4.16 consensus. The P/E leg moves from $73 to $70. Second, my EV/EBITDA leg deducted only ~$15B for NCI against a ~$52B market value; even after raising the multiple to 8.5x (the market pays ~9x consolidated), that leg falls from $69 to ~$60, and I down-weighted it to 0.2. I added an attributable FCF-yield leg (~$67). Follow-up research stayed in the alternative lane with specialist price trackers and Indonesian-language press. SMM (Sep 29-30) confirms the COMEX-LME arbitrage window is closed, so my round-1 'Comex tariff premium' wording was stale. LME closed the week at $14,457/t (~$6.56/lb), stocks are rising, and SMM expects a further near-term dip. I disagree slightly with the supervisor on the overhang: SMM argues that if the tariff is dropped, the ~770k st of COMEX stock would not return overseas quickly because re-export is costly. I therefore treat the overhang as a slower, smaller bear driver than the supervisor does. Indonesian press (Bisnis, Beritasela) adds 200k tpd ore by 2027 (vs 156k in 2026), a 75% H1-2027 step and the Manyar smelter restart in Sept 2026. The concentrate export permit lapsed in Sept 2025 and was not renewed, so PTFI now depends on the smelter. That is a watch item rather than a number-mover. Prediction markets had no current copper-tariff market with usable odds. Distribution: median lowered from $73.5 to ~$70 (spot is above my $67 fair value, but copper spot is above my deck and the 2028 full-Grasberg view supports ~$72), at ~42% lognormal vol with a 20% weight on a 1.35x wider component for fat tails. Scenarios are $45/$71/$108 at 25/50/25 (mean ~$74; the right skew comes from the lognormal). Research limited to ~6 queries this round.
